mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( ccb.BATCH_CODE, - 4 ) ) AS count_By_Day FROM con_confirm_batch ccb WHERE trunc( ccb.creation_date ) = trunc( SYSDATE ) and ccb.BATCH_CODE NOT LIKE 'QRH-J-%' ORDER BY ccb.BATCH_CODE DESC ) t WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR( ccb.BATCH_CODE, - 4 ) ) AS count_By_Day FROM con_confirm_batch ccb WHERE trunc( ccb.creation_date ) = trunc( SYSDATE ) and ccb.BATCH_CODE LIKE 'QRH-J-%' ORDER BY ccb.BATCH_CODE DESC ) t WHERE ROWNUM = 1

select ccb.batch_id, ccb.batch_code, ccb.refresh_status, (select v.MEANING from SYS_CODE_VALUE_B_V v where v.code = 'CONFIRM_REFRESH_STATUS' and v.CODE_VALUE = ccb.refresh_status) as refresh_status_n, ccb.refresh_date, ccb.created_by, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=ccb.created_by) CREATED_BY_N, ccb.creation_date, (SELECT cc.manufacturer_id FROM CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc, CON_CONTRACT cc WHERE ccb.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID AND cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS manufacturer_id, (SELECT hm.bp_name FROM CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc, CON_CONTRACT cc, hls_bp_master hm WHERE ccb.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID AND cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND hm.bp_id = cc.manufacturer_id AND ROWNUM = 1) AS manufacturer_id_n, f.factory_id, f.factory_id_n from con_confirm_batch ccb LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.BATCH_ID, wm_concat(t.factory_id) AS factory_id, wm_concat(t.BP_NAME) AS factory_id_n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ccb.BATCH_ID, cc.factory_id, (SELECT hm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hm WHERE hm.bp_id = cc.factory_id) AS BP_NAME FROM CON_CONFIRM_BATCH ccb LEFT JOIN CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc ON ccb.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc ON cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID) t GROUP BY t.BATCH_ID) f ON ccb.BATCH_ID = f.BATCH_ID
ccb.BATCH_CODE NOT LIKE 'QRH-J-%'
and (exists( select 1 from fnd_org_unit fu, sys_user_allocation su,fnd_employee_assigns fa where su.user_id=#{createdBy} and su.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=fa.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID and fa.unit_id =fu.unit_id and fu.unit_code != 'BUSINESS_DEPT_MANUFACTURER') OR exists( select 1 from fnd_employee a2,fnd_employee_assigns a3,FND_ORG_POSITION a4 where a3.employee_id=a2.employee_id and a4.position_id=a3.position_id and employee_code=#{request.employeeCode} AND A4.position_id IN(select b.position_id from sys_user_allocation a,fnd_employee_assigns b where a.employee_assign_id=b.employee_assign_id AND (a.user_id =ccb.created_by or a.user_id=(SELECT m.created_by FROM CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc, CON_CONTRACT cc,hls_bp_master m WHERE ccb.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID AND cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID and m.bp_id=cc.tenant_id AND ROWNUM = 1)) )) )
and ccb.batch_code LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{batchCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
and ccb.refresh_status = #{refreshStatus}
and trunc(ccb.creation_date) >= to_date(#{creatTimeFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(#{creatTimeTo},'yyyy-mm-dd') >=trunc(ccb.creation_date)
and trunc(ccb.refresh_date) >= to_date(#{refreshDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and trunc(ccb.refresh_date) <= to_date(#{refreshDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and (SELECT cc.manufacturer_id FROM CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc, CON_CONTRACT cc WHERE ccb.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID AND cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) = #{manufacturerId}
and f.factory_id like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{factoryId},'%'))

select cbt.batch_id, cbt.batch_code, cbt.refresh_status, cbt.refresh_date, cbt.factory_id, cbt.manufacturer_id, cbt.object_version_number, cbt.request_id, cbt.program_id, cbt.created_by, to_char(cbt.creation_date,'yyyy-mm-dd') as creat_date, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=cbt.created_by) as user_name, ( SELECT hm.bp_name FROM CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc, CON_CONTRACT cc, hls_bp_master hm WHERE cbt.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID AND cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND hm.bp_id = cc.MANUFACTURER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS manufacturer_name, (select hm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hm where hm.bp_id =cbt.factory_id) as factory_name from con_confirm_batch cbt where cbt.batch_id =#{batchId}

select a.* from (select ccb.batch_id, ccb.batch_code, ccb.refresh_status, (select v.MEANING from SYS_CODE_VALUE_B_V v where v.code = 'CONFIRM_REFRESH_STATUS' and v.CODE_VALUE = ccb.refresh_status) as refresh_status_n, ccb.refresh_date, ccb.created_by, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=ccb.created_by) CREATED_BY_N, ccb.creation_date, ( SELECT hm.bp_name FROM CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc, CON_CONTRACT cc, hls_bp_master hm WHERE ccb.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID AND cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND hm.bp_id = cc.manufacturer_id AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS manufacturer_id_n, f.FACTORY_ID, f.FACTORY_ID_N, ( SELECT hm.bp_name FROM CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc, CON_CONTRACT cc, hls_bp_master hm WHERE ccb.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID AND cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND hm.bp_id = cc.bp_id_vender AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS bp_id_vender_n, (SELECT m.created_by FROM CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc, CON_CONTRACT cc,hls_bp_master m WHERE ccb.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID AND cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID and m.bp_id=cc.tenant_id AND ROWNUM = 1) tenant_created_by from con_confirm_batch ccb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.BATCH_ID, wm_concat ( t.factory_id ) AS factory_id, wm_concat ( t.BP_NAME ) AS factory_id_n FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ccb.BATCH_ID, cc.factory_id, ( SELECT hm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hm WHERE hm.bp_id = cc.factory_id ) AS BP_NAME FROM CON_CONFIRM_BATCH ccb LEFT JOIN CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc ON ccb.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc ON cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID ) t GROUP BY t.BATCH_ID ) f ON ccb.BATCH_ID = f.BATCH_ID) a
a.BATCH_CODE LIKE 'QRH-J-%'
and (exists( select 1 from fnd_org_unit fu, sys_user_allocation su,fnd_employee_assigns fa where su.user_id=#{createdBy} and su.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=fa.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID and fa.unit_id =fu.unit_id and fu.unit_code != 'BUSINESS_DEPT_MANUFACTURER') OR exists( select 1 from fnd_employee a2,fnd_employee_assigns a3,FND_ORG_POSITION a4 where a3.employee_id=a2.employee_id and a4.position_id=a3.position_id and employee_code=#{request.employeeCode} AND A4.position_id IN(select b.position_id from sys_user_allocation aua,fnd_employee_assigns b where aua.employee_assign_id=b.employee_assign_id AND (aua.user_id =a.created_by or aua.user_id=a.tenant_created_by) )) )
and a.batch_code LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{batchCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
and a.refresh_status = #{refreshStatus}
and trunc(a.creation_date) >= to_date(#{creatTimeFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(#{creatTimeTo},'yyyy-mm-dd') >=trunc(a.creation_date)
and (SELECT cc.manufacturer_id FROM CON_BUSINESS_CONFIRM cbc,CON_CONTRACT cc WHERE a.BATCH_ID = cbc.BATCH_ID AND cbc.CONTRACT_ID = cc.CONTRACT_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) = #{manufacturerId}
and INSTR( TO_CHAR( a.FACTORY_ID ), #{factoryId} ) > 0
and a.bp_id_vender_n LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{dealerId},'%'))
